name: get_env_state
description: Return the current internal state of the environment.

name: register_zone
description: Register a new security zone to be monitored.

responsible_contact.description: Phone number or contact ID of the person responsible for this zone.

name: get_zone
description: Retrieve the current state of a security zone.

name: list_zones
description: List all registered security zones, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: [Optional] Filter by zone status. Must be one of: 'normal', 'alert', 'lockdown', 'offline'.

name: update_zone_status
description: Update the operational status of a security zone.

status.description: New status. Must be one of: 'normal', 'alert', 'lockdown', 'offline'.

name: raise_alert
description: Raise an intrusion alert for a monitored zone.

zone_id.description: Zone where the intrusion was detected.

level.description: Alert severity level. Must be one of: 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'.

description.description: Human-readable description of the detected anomaly.

sensor_worker_id.description: [Optional] Worker ID of the sensor that detected the intrusion.

name: get_alert
description: Retrieve a specific alert by its ID.

name: list_alerts
description: List all alerts, optionally filtered by zone, status, or severity level.

name: resolve_alert
description: Mark an alert as resolved or a false alarm, and restore the zone to normal status.

resolution.description: Resolution type. Must be one of: 'resolved', 'false_alarm'.

name: link_alert_to_pipeline
description: Link an alert to a response pipeline for traceability.

name: register_worker
description: Register a new security device or service worker.

name.description: Display name for the worker (e.g. 'Front Door Lock', 'Camera-01').

worker_type.description: Device/service type. Must be one of: 'door_controller', 'alarm_dialer', 'camera', 'sms_gateway', 'sensor'.

capabilities.description: [Optional] List of action types this worker can perform (e.g. ['lock_door', 'unlock_door']).

zone_id.description: [Optional] Zone this worker is assigned to.

name: unregister_worker
description: Remove a security device or service worker from the system.

name: list_workers
description: List registered workers, optionally filtered by type, status, or zone.

name: define_pipeline
description: Define a new security response pipeline with an ordered list of stages.

stages.description: Ordered list of stage definitions. Each stage requires: - stage_id (str): Unique stage identifier within this pipeline. - name (str): Human-readable stage name. - action (str): Action type to execute (e.g. 'lock_door', 'dial_emergency', 'backup_video', 'send_sms'). - params (Dict): Parameters for the action (e.g. contact number, cloud bucket). - on_failure (str): [Optional] 'abort', 'skip', or 'retry'. Defaults to 'abort'. - max_retries (int): [Optional] Max retries if on_failure='retry'. Defaults to 1. - depends_on (List[str]): [Optional] Stage IDs that must complete first. - assigned_worker (str): [Optional] Worker ID for this stage.

name: get_pipeline
description: Retrieve the full state of a response pipeline.

name: list_pipelines
description: List all response pipelines, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: [Optional] Filter by pipeline status. Must be one of: 'pending', 'in_progress', 'awaiting_approval', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'rolled_back'.

name: assign_stage
description: Assign a security worker/device to a specific stage in a pipeline.

worker_id.description: Worker ID to assign (must be a registered security device).

name: execute_stage
description: Execute a single security response stage within a pipeline.

name: execute_pipeline
description: Execute all pending stages in a security response pipeline.
